findings.reason: The protected implementation is output-correct but extends the current sentence with self.current += c. Because current is an immutable Python string stored on an attribute, every keystroke copies the complete growing prefix, taking O(L^2) prefix-building work for a sentence of length L and contradicting the branch's strict O(C + Q) derivation. The legal L = 200 maximum caps the damage but still copies 20,100 cumulative prefix characters for one maximum sentence.

The inert candidate keeps typed characters in an explicitly annotated list, appends each ordinary character in amortized O(1), and joins exactly once when # completes the sentence. At L = 200, buffering plus joining processes about 400 character positions instead of 20,100 cumulative prefix positions. All trie, ranking, learning, reset, and app-adapter logic remains direct, conventional, and interview-ready.

Initialization aggregates historical frequencies and considers every sentence at each node on its trie path, so each prefix cache begins with its exact best three under (-frequency, sentence) ordering. Later only the completed sentence's frequency changes; combining that sentence with the old top three is sufficient because every unchanged excluded sentence still ranks below the unchanged cached members. Ordinary input follows one prefix edge, missing prefixes remain empty, and # joins, learns, and resets the complete buffered sentence.

Authenticated Premium source hash 4f375d5eeb3b20825a9eac9fed200504d2386bf935990367a3f4ba827834088a, metadata, cases, and all reviewed forms agree on historical sentences and frequencies, hot-degree ranking, ASCII tie order, the top-three limit, fewer-match behavior, typed-prefix accumulation, # storage and reset, sentence and frequency limits, and at most 5000 input calls.

The protected app source and immutable native source retain SHA-256 values 24184cf68bd1e87fa4ea2991807a842c000166e0f30129a869e308a0bf054c92 and a9f9e14dd312dc56f82eee41534c5f9df29cbd2aef0315600517eb767497a3f8, and verified submission 2065507081 remains untouched. candidate.py is separate inert proposal evidence; it is not promoted, submitted, or represented as remotely Accepted.

The unchanged 8-, 32-, and 100-sentence workloads span 12.5x and exercise cached ranking against repeated corpus scans. The exact candidate passed all thirteen outputs and scaling at -0.00 extra growth with a 0.98x largest-tier ratio; the protected reference also passed. An independently correct full-corpus filter-and-sort control passed every output but failed only scaling at +0.59 extra growth and 3.53x. Separate exact work accounting proves the candidate changes prefix construction from L(L + 1)/2 copied characters to O(L) buffer-and-join work.
